content:
Password

What do you mean by "Why doesn't Thunderbird for Android ask for a password "

Are you referring to an app unlock password you enter each time you open the app. If so, that feature is not provided / supported.

If you mean during account setup, you expected to be prompted for your account password, the QR code scan can transfer the password if you selected that option in TB desktop.

Certificate error

The app is telling you there is a domain name mismatch. Your connecting to mail.first-rate.info but the certificate provided by the server is attesting CN=*.dreamhost.com.

If you expect this, you can choose to trust the certificate and continue. This will allow you to receive your emails in TB Android.

"So now I can't see my emails on Thunderbird for Desktop." What issue are you seeing on the desktop. Setting up email on your phone doesn't stop desktop working.

Are you using Imap or pop3 on your desktop and phone?
